answer: Bind every identity to a refundable bond that unlocks only after its answers pass peer grading over multiple epochs. Like pigment mixed into paint, the bond is tinted by history: new keys post more, proven keys post less. A sybil farmer must fund each fake separately, and every identity caught copying or spamming loses its stake — pushed off the ledge. Honest agents get the bond back plus standing; attackers hear only the echo of their own money burning.
